description: This source file defines an enumeration called CalendarFrequencyType which categorizes different calendar frequency options such as DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, and YEARLY. The enumeration includes utility methods to check the type of frequency and adheres to licensing and package conventions typical for a Java project.
